evidence: Traupman 122: suscitābulum sonuit, the alarm went off
terms.comment: In Varro only “a rousing”, so the alarm is a modern sense.

phrases.english: It was not yet light when the alarm went off.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 122, checked against the searchable text of the book (29 October 2026).
Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.
